description: Structured eval definitions for the Batch Compute Environment Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Batch compute topologies (EC2 with BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE and launch template, Fargate with job queue and job definition, spot with SPOT_CAPACITY_OPTIMIZED and On-Demand fallback plus array jobs, missing instance role prerequisite failure, invalid allocation strategy for spot prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: EC2 Batch compute environment with BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE and launch template
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — EC2 compute environment, BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE, launch template, job queue with priority
eval_cases.prompt: Create an AWS Batch EC2 compute environment named batch-ec2-prod in us-east-1. Use BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE allocation strategy. Instance types: m5.large, m5.xlarge, m5.2xlarge. Instance role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/batch-instance-profile. Launch template batch-custom-lt. Min vCPUs 0, max 256, desired 0. Subnets subnet-aaa11122, subnet-bbb22233. Security group sg-batch111. Create a job queue production-queue with priority 500 referencing this compute environment. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BATCH_COMPUTE: batch-ec2-prod (EC2, BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Compute environment type: EC2
  [✓] Compute environment name: batch-ec2-prod
  [✓] State: ENABLED
  [✓] Allocation strategy: BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE
  [✓] Instance types: m5.large, m5.xlarge, m5.2xlarge
  [✓] Instance role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/batch-instance-profile
  [✓] Launch template: batch-custom-lt ($Default)
  [✓] Min vCPUs: 0, Max vCPUs: 256, Desired vCPUs: 0
  [✓] Subnets: subnet-aaa11122, subnet-bbb22233
  [✓] Security groups: sg-batch111
  [✓] Job queue: production-queue (priority: 500, compute environments: batch-ec2-prod)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws batch describe-compute-environments --compute-environments batch-ec2-prod
  aws batch describe-job-queues --job-queues production-queue

eval_cases.name: Fargate Batch compute environment with job queue and job definition
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Fargate compute environment, job queue with priority, job definition with container image, vCPUs, memory, environment variables, Fargate platform LATEST
eval_cases.prompt: Create an AWS Batch Fargate compute environment named batch-fargate-prod in us-east-1. Max vCPUs 128. Subnets subnet-aaa11122, subnet-bbb22233. Security group sg-batch-fargate. Create a job queue fargate-queue with priority 300. Register a job definition data-etl-v1 with image 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/data-etl:latest, vCPUs 2, memory 4096 MB. Environment variables: S3_BUCKET=etl-data, LOG_LEVEL=INFO. Fargate platform version LATEST. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=etl.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BATCH_COMPUTE: batch-fargate-prod (Fargate)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Compute environment type: Fargate
  [✓] Compute environment name: batch-fargate-prod
  [✓] State: ENABLED
  [✓] Max vCPUs: 128
  [✓] Subnets: subnet-aaa11122, subnet-bbb22233
  [✓] Security groups: sg-batch-fargate
  [✓] Job queue: fargate-queue (priority: 300)
  [✓] Job definition: data-etl-v1 (image: data-etl:latest, vCPUs: 2, memory: 4096 MB)
  [✓] Fargate platform version: LATEST

eval_cases.name: Spot with SPOT_CAPACITY_OPTIMIZED, On-Demand fallback, and array jobs
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — spot CE with SPOT_CAPACITY_OPTIMIZED, On-Demand fallback CE with BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE, dual-CE job queue, array job of 100 with sequential dependency
eval_cases.prompt: Create a spot Batch compute environment batch-spot-env in us-east-1 with SPOT_CAPACITY_OPTIMIZED. Instance types m5.large, m5.xlarge, c5.large, c5.xlarge. Max vCPUs 1000. Spot fleet role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/aws-service-role/spotfleet.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet. Also create an On-Demand fallback batch-ondemand-env with BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE, max vCPUs 200. Create job queue production-queue priority 500 referencing spot (order 1) and ondemand (order 2). Submit an array job of size 100 with sequential dependency on a preceding ingest job. Instance role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/batch-instance-profile. Subnets subnet-aaa11122, subnet-bbb22233. SG sg-batch111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BATCH_COMPUTE: batch-spot-env (EC2, SPOT_CAPACITY_OPTIMIZED)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Allocation strategy: SPOT_CAPACITY_OPTIMIZED
  [✓] Instance types: m5.large, m5.xlarge, c5.large, c5.xlarge
  [✓] Max vCPUs: 1000
  [✓] Spot fleet role: AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet
  [✓] Fallback CE: batch-ondemand-env (BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE, max 200 vCPUs)
  [✓] Job queue: production-queue (priority: 500, CE order: spot→ondemand)
  [✓] Job dependencies: sequential (array size: 100, depends on ingest)

eval_cases.name: EC2 Batch compute environment with missing instance role (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — no instance role specified; EC2 instances cannot register with ECS agent
eval_cases.prompt: Create an AWS Batch EC2 compute environment named batch-ec2-env in us-east-1. BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE. Instance types m5.large, m5.xlarge. No instance role specified. Min vCPUs 0, max 128. Subnets subnet-aaa11122. Security group sg-batch111. Create job queue my-queue priority 100.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BATCH_COMPUTE: batch-ec2-env (EC2, BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Instance role: MISSING — EC2 compute environment requires an instance role with ecs.amazonaws.com trust policy

eval_cases.name: Spot compute environment with BEST_FIT (invalid allocation strategy)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — BEST_FIT does not support spot; spot requires SPOT_CAPACITY_OPTIMIZED
eval_cases.prompt: Create an AWS Batch spot compute environment named batch-spot-env in us-east-1 with BEST_FIT allocation strategy. Instance types m5.large, m5.xlarge. Max vCPUs 500. Instance role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/batch-instance-profile. Spot fleet role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/aws-service-role/spotfleet.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForEC2SpotFleet. Subnets subnet-aaa11122. SG sg-batch111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BATCH_COMPUTE: batch-spot-env (EC2, BEST_FIT)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Allocation strategy: INVALID — spot compute environments require SPOT_CAPACITY_OPTIMIZED, not BEST_FIT
